name: Ireland
deceptionLabel: The USC 'Surcharge' That Isn't Really a Surcharge
note: Headline is a clean 20/40% system with credits — but USC is a fully separate parallel tax that credits don't touch

layers.label: Income Tax (PAYE)
layers.note: Standard rate cut-off €44,000 for single person

layers.label: Personal Tax Credit
layers.note: Fixed credit — same value regardless of tax rate

layers.label: Employee (PAYE) Tax Credit
layers.note: Combined with personal credit = €4,000 total. DOES NOT reduce USC.

layers.label: Universal Social Charge (USC) (!!!)
layers.note: Completely separate from income tax. Tax credits give ZERO relief here. This is the deception — it looks like a minor 'charge' but at higher salaries the 8% band is brutal.

layers.label: PRSI (Pay Related Social Insurance)
layers.note: 4.1% Jan-Sep 2025, 4.2% Oct-Dec 2025. Using blended effective rate of ~4.175% but 4.2% for simplicity. Flat on ALL income — no cap, no upper limit.
